title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker remains skeptical about Red Sox's playoff chances despite their recent hot streak.
Red Sox currently hold second A.L. wild-card with a 64-52 record, after a significant performance turnaround.
FanGraphs estimates Red Sox have a 96% chance to make the playoffs, conflicting with Parker's predictions.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu of the Boston Red Sox was scratched from Saturday's lineup due to leg swelling.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return to the lineup for Sunday's game against the Athletics.
Abreu, with 20 home runs and 62 RBIs, has been a key player for the Red Sox this season.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox' nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics on Saturday evening.
Boston's offense struggled, leaving 12 runners on base and striking out 15 times despite out-hitting the Athletics 10-8.
Starting pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings, leading to the Red Sox's sixth loss in 38 games.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium will replace its turf for a second time due to NFL compliance rules.
The newly installed turf failed to meet NFL lab testing protocols lacking an 'E-layer'.
Kraft Sports Group requested a retest, but the next window isn't until early 2027.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium with goals by Guilherme and Agustin Resch.
Jack Harrison made his New England Revolution debut, coming on in the 55th minute but struggled to make an impact.
Houston Dynamo secured their victory with a 63rd-minute goal from Agustin Resch, capitalizing on a corner kick opportunity.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony has been out since May with a wrist injury; he is now hitting off a pitching machine.
Adley Rutschman made his first rehab appearance for the Worcester Red Sox, catching for five innings.
The Red Sox are on a 9-game winning streak as they await Anthony and Rutschman's returns.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix features 'Clueless,' a 1995 classic starring Alicia Silverstone, and Bo Burnham's 2018 film 'Eighth Grade.'
'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' and 'The Ballad of Wallis Island' are highlighted as top streaming picks for August.
Season 4 of 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' and 'Ted Lasso' are recommended by Boston.com staff for August.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting on July 5 in Voluntown, Connecticut.
Since 1994, there have been 126 verified Bigfoot sightings in New England, according to BFRO.
Biologist Eva Garrett states no scientific evidence supports the existence of Bigfoot-like creatures.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers and advice columnist, passed away last month at age 86.
Howard, known for writing Dear Prudence and Dear Margo, offered practical, empathetic advice often with humor.
Author reflects on lessons from Margo Howard, emphasizing finding happiness post-loss and avoiding prolonged grief.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 batters in the Red Sox's 13-1 win over the Athletics.
The Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games with 15 hits and multiple high-scoring innings.
Raymond Burgos made his Red Sox debut, pitching three hitless innings after being recalled from Triple-A Worcester.
